results.title: Globex — Account Notes
snippets: Globex is Sample Corp's largest customer account, owned by Sam Reyes (Account Executive). Current ARR: $840,000, up from $620,000 at last renewal.
Primary contacts: VP of Engineering (executive sponsor) and a Director of IT Operations (day-to-day admin). Deployment: 1,200 licensed seats.

results.title: Globex — Renewal Status (Q3 2026)
snippets: Globex's contract renews 2026-09-30. Status: on track, verbally committed to renew at current seat count with a discussion in progress about adding 300 seats for the newly onboarded business unit.
Open items: legal is finalizing an updated data processing addendum requested by Globex's security team; procurement wants a multi-year discount quote. Risk level: low.

results.title: Globex — Security Questionnaire Response Summary
snippets: SOC 2 Type II report provided (current, renewed annually), data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+), data residency confirmed as US-only per Globex's requirement.

SSO/SAML supported, and a documented incident-response process with a 24-hour customer notification SLA for confirmed breaches. Globex's security team accepted all responses with no follow-up questions.
